Part three. FTX. So where did the money go? Prosecutors said customer money deposited at FTX had secretly been sent to Alameda, and used for risky trades, investments, political donations and real estate in the Bahamas. Billions of dollars were missing. In December twenty twenty-two, Sam was arrested in the Bahamas and sent to the United States. His closest colleagues, including Alameda's boss Caroline Ellison, pleaded guilty and testified against him. In November twenty twenty-three, a jury found Sam guilty on all seven counts of fraud and conspiracy. In March twenty twenty-four, he was sentenced to twenty-five years in prison. From the next Warren Buffett, to a prison cell. Rise... and ruin. Follow for more.
